input_freeze.immutability: All files and artifacts named above are read-only. Candidate work may add new source and the one authorized unexported local-solver kernel refactor; it may not update an expected hash to accept drift.

allowed_observations: the frozen card, amendment, locks, visibility and baseline contracts
candidate-visible typed graphs, oracle programs, bounds, scales, starts and budgets
frozen generator and K0 source code needed to reproduce byte-identical black-box semantics
public product source and public baseline snapshot
result_blind_attestation.rule: Any observation of assessor truth, Gold values, K0 result records, prior JAC001/JAC002 materialized inputs or any outcome before candidate, harness and analysis source freeze terminates EXP-JAC-003.

claims.primary: K1-CACHED-ROUTED improves fully charged counterbalanced end-to-end wall by at least 10 percent overall, with a family-clustered one-sided 95 percent lower bound above zero and no overall regression in either K1 repetition.
claims.oracle_work: K1 reduces primal-equivalent oracle work by at least 20 percent in each of the three eligible families, with each family-clustered one-sided 95 percent lower bound above zero.
claims.recall: K1 loses no more than two percentage points of independently assessed P_local_gold overall or in any required family, branch, boundary or generator stratum.
claims.dense_control: The dense/branch control has at most five percent fully charged wall overhead without recall gain, and every route projection with color_count / variable_count at least 0.8 chooses dense.
claim_boundary: The claims cover exactly the 64 frozen development cases and their saved 32-start prefixes until a separate result-blind locked-family protocol is preregistered after a complete development pass.

They do not establish completeness of the global geometry solver, automatic differentiation performance, Hessian performance, sampled sparsity safety or gains on graphs outside the four frozen JAC003 families.
KA-REBUILD-ATTRIBUTION and all kernel microtimings are report-only and cannot promote, reject or retune K1.
A development pass authorizes only creation of generator-disjoint locked inputs. It does not authorize product connection.

pipeline: A pairing owner reads opaque_case_id solely to select one candidate payload and saved start_index.
A black-box evaluator owner receives only an immutable oracle_program value and numerical point.
A compiler owner receives only typed_graph, declared numeric types and operation contracts; every call dependency is treated conservatively as the union of all argument dependencies.

The compiler emits two freshly allocated immutable projections: ProviderProjection(row_supports, groups, structural_nonzeros) and RouteProjection(variable_count, residual_count, structural_nonzeros, color_count).
The route consumes RouteProjection only. If dense is selected, the unchanged public solve_local path is invoked without jacobian_entries.
If colored is selected, the provider constructor consumes ProviderProjection only, validates it once, seals it to one compiled-case lifetime and invokes an unexported shared local-solver kernel.
Starts, bounds, scales and the evaluator are owned by the compiled case runner, but are never passed to the provider constructor or route.
The runner and every case-owned provider are destroyed before the next case; no state or cache crosses a case or process boundary.

typed_graph_compiler.reference_rule: A reference node contributes exactly its validated zero-based variable_slot converted to one-based solver indexing.
typed_graph_compiler.call_rule: A call node contributes the union of dependencies of every declared argument. Operation identity and literal values never enter the provider or route projection.
typed_graph_compiler.relation_rule: Relation order defines one-based residual rows. Every relation must resolve to an existing relation-typed live node.
validation: node IDs are nonempty and unique
references are in range and each variable slot is represented
arguments refer only to existing earlier nodes
relations are unique and in range
all row supports are sorted, unique and conservative
unsupported node kinds, numeric types, graph versions or cycles fail before route construction
typed_graph_compiler.natural_coloring: Visit columns in one-based natural order and place each active column into the first group whose occupied residual rows are disjoint; otherwise append a new group. Empty-support columns are recorded as inactive and are not probed. Active groups plus inactive columns form a complete unique partition of all variable columns.

constructor_checks: each row support is a sorted unique tuple of integers in 1:residual_count
structural_nonzeros equals the exact sum of row-support lengths
each active column appears in exactly one nonempty group and each inactive column appears in no group
every column in a group has nonempty support
columns in the same group have pairwise-disjoint row supports
groups and columns follow the frozen natural first-fit order
all fields are copied into immutable tuples before construction
provider_projection.seal: The sealed provider records residual_count, variable_count and the canonical SHA-256 of the provider projection. The dimensions are rechecked at kernel entry; its immutable tuple fields are never exposed to the evaluator or route.

route_projection.formula_text: colored iff c < n and 2*c + nnz/(4*n) <= 0.8*(2*n)
route_projection.arithmetic: Use overflow-free integer arithmetic for the exact equivalent after validating n > 0, m > 0, 0 <= nnz <= m*n and 0 <= c <= n.

shared_kernel_refactor.authorized_product_edit: Extract exactly one unexported local iteration kernel receiving an internal Jacobian source as a positional argument. The exported solve_local wrappers retain byte-for-byte-equivalent arguments, keyword order, defaults, dense behavior and public colored behavior.
shared_kernel_refactor.public_dense_source: The public direct method supplies the dense internal source when jacobian_entries is nothing. The public problem method continues to call the public direct method.
shared_kernel_refactor.public_colored_source: The public direct method supplies a deferred entries source when jacobian_entries is present so construction remains per public call and after residual-count discovery, as at baseline.
shared_kernel_refactor.research_source: Only the research candidate calls the unexported kernel with a sealed case-owned provider. No new export, public method, keyword, option or protocol field is added.
forbidden: prepared_coloring token in the exported signature
provider in ProblemSpec, SolveOptions, checkpoint or wire JSON
connection to _CompiledAttemptRunner or the global search loop
SOLVE_API_VERSION, ABI, DSL or wire-version change

numerical_semantics.finite_difference_step: The unchanged LocalSolveOptions finite_difference_step and normalized-coordinate step rule are used.
numerical_semantics.group_probe: For one color group, apply the independently clamped plus perturbation to every group column in one callback and the independently clamped minus perturbation in one callback. Decompress only rows in that column's conservative support.
numerical_semantics.one_sided_bounds: For each column, use central difference when both signed steps are positive, otherwise the available one-sided difference. A column with neither signed step usable makes the group unusable.
group_unusable: a required grouped callback is not EVAL_OK
the residual length differs from residual_count
a signed perturbation expected to move a column does not move it
the provider dimension or seal check fails
numerical_semantics.fallback: Before a group probe starts, reserve the maximum work for its two grouped callbacks plus both individual callbacks for every affected active column. If the group is unusable, discard all grouped derivatives and retry every affected column independently in natural order. A failed independent retry fails the attempt closed; partial grouped or partial fallback derivatives are never used.
numerical_semantics.endpoint_replay: Every returned endpoint is replayed with the same black-box evaluator, and the independent assessor later applies canonical truth. Candidate code never reads Gold while executing.
numerical_semantics.dense_differential: Before any timed segment, compare K1 Jacobian entries with independently evaluated dense finite differences at the frozen safety points and starts using card-frozen tolerances. No comparison result may alter route, support, color, step or fallback behavior.

callback_reservation.trial: one additional callback is reserved before each iteration
callback_reservation.rule: If the complete next-iteration reservation exceeds max_evaluations, return LOCAL_MAX_EVALUATIONS before issuing a callback.

hard_budgets.case_deadline: One monotonic absolute deadline is created before case compilation. Compilation, route, provider construction, all 32 starts and endpoint replay consume that deadline. No new per-start 180-second allowance is created.
hard_budgets.timeout_accounting: At the hard case deadline, the case remains in the paired sample with 180 seconds charged, zero Gold success for every unfinished start and budget-exhausted records for all unstarted or incomplete starts.
hard_budgets.overflow_and_count_failure: Counter overflow, negative work, callback count disagreement or post-deadline callback entry is a nonzero budget_overrun_count and kills the experiment.

negative_controls: KNEG-INCOMPLETE-PATTERN removes one real compiler dependency after compilation; the frozen dense differential must detect it and no timed run may begin.
A canary payload containing every route/provider forbidden field must remain unreachable from both projection types and constructor call graphs.
Duplicate, missing, out-of-range, overlapping same-color and non-natural group projections must all be rejected before any callback.
Forced invalid plus, invalid minus, nonfinite and residual-length group probes must each retry every affected column or fail the attempt closed.
A provider built for one dimension or structural projection must be rejected by a different compiled runner.
terminal_failures: Any negative control is not detected.
Any incomplete ABBA segment, staging mismatch, lease loss, nonzero child exit or host contention occurs.
P_local_gold loses more than two percentage points in any required stratum.
Eligible-family oracle-work reduction is below ten percent in any eligible family.
Fully charged K1 wall exceeds K0 overall, or dense-control overhead exceeds five percent without recall gain.
Any JAC001/JAC002 materialized input or outcome is accessed, or any frozen development artifact is changed.

harness_and_analysis_freeze.processes: Four fresh single-thread Julia processes under one exclusive audit; one case compile and one provider at most per K1 case; no writable depot state crosses segments.
harness_and_analysis_freeze.case_order: Ascending opaque_case_id in every segment; 32 saved starts in serialized order.
trace_minimum: opaque_case_id only in pairing and output owner records
route/provider projection field-name lists and canonical hashes
route decision and exact structural counts
compile, provider, attempt, endpoint replay and fully charged walls
callback and primal-equivalent oracle-work counts including grouped failures and fallback
local status, final point, residual, branch observation and canonical replay record
harness_and_analysis_freeze.aggregation: Use the amendment's case-paired ABBA means and deterministic 20000-replicate family-cluster bootstrap with namespace jac3-analysis-v1. Timeouts are retained at the hard charge; missing or failed segments invalidate the whole sequence.
harness_and_analysis_freeze.assessor_boundary: A separate post-execution assessor process owns the frozen assessor and K0 artifacts. It joins only by opaque_case_id plus start_index, cannot mutate candidate records, and cannot construct a provider or route before execution.
harness_and_analysis_freeze.publication: All four segment traces stay in nonofficial staging and are atomically published together only after source, input, process isolation, complete sequence, contention and ownership audits pass.

implementation_order: Commit this preregistration as the sole change before candidate mechanism source exists.
Implement and statically review the unexported shared-kernel refactor and research-only candidate compiler, projections, sealed provider and route.
Implement the result-blind evaluator, safety/negative harness, formal segment runner and independent post-execution assessor/aggregator without opening outcomes.
Freeze all mechanism, test, harness, analysis and provenance sources with hashes.
Only after the active cross-worktree heavy-run lock is released, run parse, unit, differential, public-surface and frozen-control tests.
Correct only implementation defects that violate this frozen mechanism; coefficients, route, budgets, input allocation and gates remain immutable.
Freeze the tested development runner, then request one exclusive four-segment formal run.
change_rule: This file is immutable after its commit. Any scientific change requires a new experiment ID. Defect corrections may only make source conform to this text and must be recorded before any outcome is opened.
